name: Link Tools
description: Shows where a short link goes, and makes short links.
expand.title: Expand short link
shorten.title: Shorten with is.gd
notShort: This is not a known short link.
noLink: There is no link to shorten.
tooMany: This short link hops through more than 5 short links.
loop: This short link leads back to itself.
noRedirect: This short link did not say where it goes.
blocked: Couldn’t read where this link goes. Its service sends the app straight to the destination, which Link Tools may not follow.
lookupFailed: is.gd couldn’t find where this link goes.
rateLimit: is.gd is busy. Try again in a minute.
badLocation: The short link points to something that is not a web link.
